data.job_description: Cognitive Cloud Labs is hiring an AI Backend Software Engineer to develop AI-driven applications and services. Key Responsibilities: Develop REST APIs with FastAPI and Python 3.11, build multi-agent graph workflows using LangGraph and LangChain, implement vector search and retrieval mechanisms, and integrate secure authentication with Supabase / PostgreSQL. Requirements: Proficient in Python, familiar with asynchronous programming (asyncio, httpx), experience with PyPDF2/pypdf or document processing pipelines, and solid foundation in cloud infrastructure.

Qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or related field
3+ years of experience with Python (FastAPI / Pydantic / AsyncIO)
Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or LLM agent architectures
Familiarity with Supabase, PostgreSQL, and vector databases
Responsibilities: Design, implement, and maintain FastAPI microservices
Build document parsing, resume analysis, and job matching pipelines
Collaborate with frontend engineers on Next.js UI integration

data.job_description: We are seeking a Lead Python Engineer to spearhead our Agentic AI product suite. You will work on cutting-edge autonomous agents for skill verification and learning pathway generation. You will architect high-concurrency async endpoints, integrate external job market feeds (Adzuna, JSearch), and extract structured insights from unstructured PDFs and resumes.

Qualifications: Expertise in asynchronous programming (httpx, asyncio, FastAPI)
Strong data parsing capabilities (PDF, Docx, JSON)
Responsibilities: Lead technical architecture of AI agent pipelines
Ensure high test coverage and fault-tolerant fallback mechanisms
Mentor junior and mid-level software engineers
